description: This file defines the Currency controller class within the Opencart catalog's common controllers. It manages currency display, saving user preferences, and localization within the OpenCart framework.

classes.name: Currency
classes.description: Controller class for handling currency-related actions such as display and save.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the currency selection page with available currencies and current selection.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the selected currency to the session, sets a cookie, and redirects to the appropriate page.
